inputs.name: id
inputs.description: ID assigned to the emitted fan-out step.

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: Runtime expression that resolves to the array of items to process.

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: Per-item argument string passed to the selected skill or command.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Model used by every item process.

inputs.name: maxTurns
inputs.description: Maximum agent turns allowed for each item.

inputs.name: allowedTools
inputs.description: Tools available to each item process.

inputs.name: disallowedTools
inputs.description: Tools or path-scoped edits denied to each item process.

inputs.name: timeoutMinutes
inputs.description: Timeout applied to the fan-out work.

inputs.name: maxParallel
inputs.description: Maximum item processes that may run concurrently.

inputs.name: toolkit
inputs.description: Required toolkit containing exactly one run skill or command.
